decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development by reason of its size, position and design constitutes over development of the site which would be unduly dominant, overshadow and overlook adjoining residents and would be incompatible with the character of the adjoining area, contrary to policies ENV1.1 (All New Development), H.1.2 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.3.3 (Backland/Infill Developments) of the Council's Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of residential building/block comprising of 8 flats and associated parking off street parking and vehicular crossovers into existing properties off Elmwood Avenue, new access road, parking and associated landscaping (with amended plans M6450/010 Received 6 March 2002)
